<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/certificate/{name}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Writes the CA from the object, or from the one that it was deployed from when the object is empty, and rebuilds the trust store when the file changed. A CA that osapi did not deploy is not found. macOS reports skipped.
